method: Image-only crop proposals fixed before fitting. Photo agreement measures the classified crop, not unavailable source artwork or cutting paths. Synthetic known-artwork error is measured separately. No fitted template or annotated overlap quad initializes either automatic photo track.

hunodan.timing: Decode, automatic detection, preparation, solve/validation, export artifact writes and independent rendering, in one Node process. No browser or worker startup. Serial single runs; no speedup claim.

notes: Red-tree crops differ; 7.024375% and 6.71125% are measured against different targets, not a directly comparable reconstruction gain.
Nested-heart red changed from 2.806875% to 2.84375% with identical corners and 4+4 cuts; both pass. The finite-budget replay did not reproduce exactly. No claim of unchanged errors for this photo.
Five of the six passing cases have exactly unchanged measured errors. The angel still has no usable crop.

browser.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.
